sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type IN ('personal', 'family')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id), "member_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'member')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type IN ('cash', 'bank', 'bkash', 'nagad', 'other')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id), "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type IN ('expense', 'income')), CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "counter_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "subcategory_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "next_due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_paused" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_paisa > 0), CHECK (type IN ('income', 'expense', 'transfer')), CHECK (frequency IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly')), CHECK (interval_count >= 1), CHECK ((type = 'transfer') = (counter_account_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((type = 'transfer') = (category_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "subcategory_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "description" TEXT NULL, "local_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "transfer_group_id" TEXT NULL, "counter_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "refund_of_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "recurring_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_paisa > 0), CHECK (type IN ('income', 'expense', 'refund', 'transfer_out', 'transfer_in')), CHECK (source IN ('manual', 'voice', 'recurring', 'repeat')), CHECK (local_date BETWEEN 19000101 AND 29991231), CHECK ((type IN ('income', 'expense', 'refund') AND category_id IS NOT NULL AND transfer_group_id IS NULL AND counter_account_id IS NULL) OR (type IN ('transfer_out', 'transfer_in') AND category_id IS NULL AND subcategory_id IS NULL AND transfer_group_id IS NOT NULL AND counter_account_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((type = 'refund') = (refund_of_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (counter_account_id IS NULL OR counter_account_id <> account_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces (id), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "amount_paisa" INTEGER NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "warning_threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_paisa > 0), CHECK (month BETWEEN 1 AND 12), CHECK (year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2999), CHECK (warning_threshold BETWEEN 1 AND 100));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_executions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id), "occurrence_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "executed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspace_members_unique ON workspace_members (workspace_id, member_ref)
CREATE INDEX accounts_workspace ON accounts (workspace_id)
CREATE INDEX categories_parent ON categories (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX categories_workspace ON categories (workspace_id)
CREATE INDEX txn_workspace_date ON transactions (workspace_id, local_date)
CREATE INDEX txn_account ON transactions (account_id)
CREATE INDEX txn_workspace_category_date ON transactions (workspace_id, category_id, local_date)
CREATE INDEX txn_transfer_group ON transactions (transfer_group_id)
CREATE INDEX txn_refund_of ON transactions (refund_of_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX budgets_unique_month ON budgets (workspace_id, category_id, year, month) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX recurring_workspace ON recurring_rules (workspace_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recurring_exec_unique ON recurring_executions (rule_id, occurrence_date)
